legacyTransactions: none: the 26.2 play protocol has no window-confirmation/transaction packet; ping/pong (int id) and keep-alive (long id) are the request/response pairs; teleport confirm and client tick end are the game-thread fences

pong.constructor: ServerboundPongPacket(int) - answered by the client's network thread; server handler is a no-op

keepAliveResponse.constructor: ServerboundKeepAlivePacket(long) - answered by the client's network thread

clientTickEnd.constructor: ServerboundClientTickEndPacket() - record, no payload, once per client tick

serverSemantics.handlePong: no-op (single return): a pong is receipt/RTT evidence only; the server neither validates nor acts on it
serverSemantics.keepAliveCadence: one ClientboundKeepAlivePacket per second per connection (System.nanoTime based challenge id, io.papermc.paper.util.KeepAlive.pendingKeepAlives queue); LATENCY_CHECK_INTERVAL=15000 exists but does not drive the cadence (P7-F3)
serverSemantics.keepAliveTimeout: KEEPALIVE_LIMIT = Long.getLong("paper.playerconnection.keepalive", 30) * 1000 ms: kicked when the oldest pending keep-alive is older than that
serverSemantics.keepAliveResponse: handleKeepAlive matches the response id against the head of the pending queue (challengeId) and feeds Paper's ping calculators; Papea2AC correlates the same long id in its MarkerLedger and never reads the server's latency field
serverSemantics.teleportConfirm: handleAcceptTeleportPacket: main thread (ensureRunningOnSameThread); accepted only when packet id == awaitingTeleport (a stale/superseded id is ignored); the server then snaps the player to awaitingPositionFromClient
serverSemantics.teleportResend: updateAwaitingTeleport: while awaitingPositionFromClient is set, an unconfirmed teleport is re-sent (same id) when tickCount - awaitingTeleportTime > 20; the id increments per internalTeleport, so a superseding correction carries a new id
serverSemantics.clientTickEnd: handleClientTickEnd: main thread; fires Paper's ClientTickEndEvent; the packet is the client's once-per-tick fence used for alignment (TICK_END_EXACT)

clientSemantics.pong: vanilla 26.2 client answers ClientboundPingPacket from the network thread (ClientCommonPacketListener.handlePing -> send(ServerboundPongPacket)): receipt evidence, no tick alignment
clientSemantics.keepAlive: answered from the network thread likewise
clientSemantics.teleportConfirm: handleMovePlayer runs on the game thread: applies the correction, sends ServerboundAcceptTeleportationPacket then the PosRot at the applied position (TimingProfile.teleportConfirmIsGameThreadFence)
clientSemantics.clientTickEnd: sent once at the end of every client tick while in a level (TimingProfile.clientTickEndPerTick; verified per session by presence and in the real-client qualification)

liveCapture.path: EmbeddedChannel -> PaperCapture -> PacketEngine shard -> TimingObservationMapper -> TimingLedger
liveCapture.playerPosition: TeleportSent(id, relative mask) then TeleportConfirmed(id); a foreign confirm id is counted stale and confirms nothing
